jobs.name: Weekly Site Audit
jobs.prompt: Run a full SEO audit of the configured target site(s). Use the seo-crawl, seo-onpage and seo-report skills in order. Compare indexability findings against the previous week's report in reports/ and flag anything that regressed. Write the report to reports/<domain>-<date>.md and summarize the top action.

jobs.name: Monthly Index Coverage
jobs.prompt: Check index coverage for the configured target site: sample the sitemap for non-200 status codes, noindex headers, canonical chains and orphans. Report only changes and new defects since the last monthly check.
